"Shift rules for the planners"
This section explains the steps that matter

Companion Animal Travel Desk Service Standards

This section sets the routine service rules for the Companion Animal Travel Desk and supports careful handling of each travel request. Staff must review every case with calm attention, confirm that the journey plan matches the animal's welfare needs, and give the traveler clear guidance that can be followed without delay. The work begins with a complete review of the booking record, required documents, carrier details, and any special comfort notes passed by the welfare coordinator. If the record is incomplete, staff must request the missing details before the trip is cleared for further action.

All communication must remain concise, kind, and actionable. Staff should explain what is needed in plain language, note any limits on the service, and avoid adding extra assumptions. When a traveler needs support at the airport, the welcome team prepares the handoff for boarding and confirms that the animal, carrier, and passenger are ready for the next step. If a concern arises, the desk must coordinate with the welfare coordinator and the relevant ground team at once so that the journey remains safe and orderly. No promise may be made unless the desk has confirmed that it can be met.

Records must be updated as soon as a service step is completed. Any change in condition, routing, or handling must be entered in the file and shared with the next team that will support the journey. Staff are expected to protect privacy, keep notes factual, and treat each journey as a shared responsibility across Aurelia Skyways. If a traveler arrives with a concern about comfort or connection, the desk should respond with patience and direct the matter to the proper support path without delay.

For questions beyond routine handling, contact the senior coordinator or the welfare coordinator through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
